system.description:
CONCENTRATE

Action 1 AP

You designate one creature as the Subject of your Inquisition, following the normal Grimward rules, except that you gain a +1 class bonus to the appropriate investigative checks against your Subject rather than the Grimward's class bonus. A feat requiring Judgement cannot be used unless you gain that ability from another source.

Use: spends 1 AP and names your Subject (the targeted token, or a name you type); +1 class is then offered in the dialog of Detect Deception, Identify Power, Recall Knowledge, Research, Search, Study Target, Track and Sense Motive checks. Use again to change or end.
